node.statement: Conclusion and dependency repair. Since L_V is invertible, p_V(a,q)=0 is equivalent by its defining exact formula to [V bold-dot(J+a+g_V(a))] bold-dot(J+q)=V. The fixed point has ||a||,||q||<rho<delta, so a is in the external graph lemma domain B^{icalH}_{2delta}(0), and that lemma makes U:=V bold-dot(J+a+g_V(a)) an element of calU. Thus V=U bold-dot(J+q) with ||q||<delta, and the preceding child gives the required uniqueness. Children 1.2.2.1 and 1.2.2.2 derive every estimate and the injectivity argument directly from the two registered definitions and lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control; pending siblings 1.1.2 and 1.2.1 are not dependencies. The corrected chain is B<delta-K_d D<=(1-theta)delta, so the equality case identified by the verifier is harmless.
